finding: The required 256/512/1024/2048 canonical chunk ladder is deterministic. Full-category chunk1024 improves weighted p1024/p4096 2.55%/2.25% but is -2.05% at p512 versus chunk512; the chunk512 p512 arm is noisy (>2% CV), and chunk2048 loses to1024 at p4096. Retain default512; 1024 is diagnostic pending a separate counterbalanced protocol.
